macros.name: copyrighttext
macros.doc: The copyright text printed on the titlepage.

macros.name: degree
macros.doc: The title of your degree (spelled out, like “Doctor of Philosophy” not “PhD”).

macros.name: gradyear
macros.doc: The year of your degree completion.

macros.name: maketitle
macros.doc: Creates the title page according to SGS requirements, and adds a blank page following if using [twoside].

envs.name: abstract
envs.doc: Creates the abstract page according to SGS requirements, and adds a blank page if using [twoside].

envs.name: dedication
envs.doc: The dedication environment formats text flush right and 1/3 down a new page.
